title: FEVM Social
tagline: Social Premitive like lens on filecoin. Generally didn't get much finished.
description:
Had some issues with deploying using foundry so didn't get much done. However it was my first hack and good experience to learn more about social and data primitives, using FEVM & data availability.

In the repo you won't find much so I don't think this is going to worth a prize but I learnt a lot and was fun.
how_its_made: Looked into using tableland and/or lens. didn't get much of the prototype done.  One repo is just Foundry and me trying to write a deploy script that works. Then hard hat project is just some playing around with the mock functions. Next hackathon I'm going to spend more time before hand to learn the protocol as I spend a lot of time reading about filecoin.
